title: ML_LTU at SemEval-2022 Task 4: T5 Towards Identifying Patronizing and Condescending Language

bias_targets.methodology: Finetuning a pretrained Text-to-Text-Transfer Transformer (T5) model for binary classification to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) in paragraphs targeting socioeconomic groups such as homeless people, poor families, and those in need.
Finetuning a pretrained T5 model for binary classification to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) in paragraphs targeting immigrants, migrants, and refugees.
Finetuning a pretrained T5 model for binary classification to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) in paragraphs targeting disabled individuals.
Finetuning a pretrained T5 model for binary classification to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) in paragraphs targeting women.
